propositions: A revised deterministic clarity floor must eliminate false positives by validating only structurally incompatible states, not prose style preferences.
Nonempty parsed acceptance-criteria checkbox items qualify as hard floor; exact duplicate AC text does not cause plan failure and must be demoted to advisory.

Bare unresolved sentinels (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) are hard floor only when occupying value positions in active execution sections, with removal assertions suppressed; the undefined history exception is rejected.
File-impact path/reason integrity belongs to write-schema validation, not clarity scoring; prerequisite citation edge-checking applies only to absent-credit grounding, not ordinary provenance.
Historical counterexample search must document every closed ticket matching both plan-review and completion-verifier attestations; legitimate matches narrow or reject the rule.
The final floor contains exactly two hard rules: nonempty AC items and unresolved sentinel assignments; all other signals remain advisory only.
